LESSON: GUIDED WRITING: SUMMARY WRITING

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Writing 3.4 Guided Writing (2 sessions) • Diary keeping By the end of the sub- s
Topic 3.6: Guided Writing: Summary Writing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Guided Writing: Summary Writing. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why do we keep our utensils clean?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate summary writing as a strategy for knowledge preservation

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GUIDED WRITING: SUMMARY WRITING
This lesson teaches Guided Writing: Summary Writing for Grade 9 ARABIC.

STUDY STEPS
1. appreciate summary writing as a strategy for knowledge preservation
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Guided Writing: Summary Writing using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Guided Writing: Summary Writing above.
2. Explain Guided Writing: Summary Writing to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Guided Writing: Summary Writing.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Guided Writing: Summary Writing with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Guided Writing: Summary Writing important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do we keep our utensils clean?
2. How can we reduce a text without leaving out key ideas?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. appreciate summary writing as a strategy for knowledge preservation

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
